title: Transmitter release is a quantum tunneling event with a probability well below one

statements.text: Each incoming nerve impulse causes the release of transmitter molecules by exocytosis. Since exocytosis is a quantal phenomenon of the presynaptic vesicular grid with a probability much less than one, Beck and Eccles model it quantum mechanically, as a tunneling process in the trigger mechanism.

sources.quote: Since exocytosis is a quantal phenomenon of the presynaptic vesicular grid with a probability much less than 1, we present a quantum mechanical model for it based on a tunneling process of the trigger mechanism.
